set.body: Acceptance criteria: offset-only synchronization accepts the PRD-required one-mark evidence while affine fitting requires sufficient marks; residuals, uncertainty, occupancy durations, and counts use validated non-negative types and coherent private result construction; tidy CSV APIs distinguish raw syntactic parsing from typed scientific decoding and validate claimed frame, clock, detector, provenance, numeric, and SHA-256 fields where typed decoding is promised; PsychologyWorkflowResult directly exposes warnings and provenance and names accepted versus rejected row counts precisely.
set.title: Make synchronization and tidy workflow claims exact
